title: 馬來西亞沙都浮式液化工程
summary: 馬來西亞沙都浮式液化工程是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為可移置浮式裝置與新氣源重新匹配；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
summaryEn: PFLNG SATU is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on matching a redeployable floater to a different gas supply, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floater motion and equipment inertia — case 1” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “PFLNG SATU”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本工程研究問題是「可移置浮式裝置與新氣源重新匹配」。以馬來西亞沙都浮式液化工程作為地理與系統脈絡，本單元建立可驗證的教學假設；下列模型並非宣稱該場址採用相同設備尺寸、工況或流程。把甲板水平加速度乘設備質量求慣性力，用來理解相同製程設備放到船體上後為何增加支承與管線介面問題。此模型只是單一方向的準靜態量級，不含六自由度耦合、波浪頻譜、疲勞或船級設計係數；不能用它決定實機繫泊或支撐尺寸。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case question is matching a redeployable floater to a different gas supply. Using PFLNG SATU as geographic and system context, this unit constructs a testable teaching scenario; it does not assert that the site has the same dimensions, conditions or flowsheet as the model. Multiply horizontal deck acceleration by equipment mass to estimate inertial force, explaining why a process unit placed on a hull creates additional support and piping interfaces. This is only a single-direction quasi-static magnitude: it omits six-degree coupling, wave spectra, fatigue and class factors and cannot size real moorings or supports. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.titleEn: Floater motion and equipment inertia — case 1: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Floater motion and equipment inertia — case 1” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：F[kN]=m[kg]·a[m/s²]/1000；代入 m = 80000 kg、a = 0.8 m/s²，得 64.0 kN（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設甲板設備的水平慣性力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 a 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: F[kN]=m[kg]·a[m/s²]/1000; with m = 80000 kg, a = 0.8 m/s² the result is 64.0 kN (teaching assumption, not site design data: horizontal inertial force of hypothetical deck equipment). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise a by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 70.4 kN（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 70.4 kN (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 64.0 kN（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 a 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 64.0 kN (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in a with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 浮體運動與設備慣性：可移置浮式裝置與新氣：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floater motion and equipment inertia — case 1: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floater motion and equipment inertia — case 1” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對可移置浮式裝置與新氣源重新匹配，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。畫設備質心與支承的力圖，分開重力和水平慣性；把加速度時序的正負峰值與均方根分列，說明平均加速度為零也不代表無載荷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For matching a redeployable floater to a different gas supply, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Sketch the centre of mass and supports, separating gravity from horizontal inertia. List positive and negative acceleration peaks and RMS, explaining why zero mean acceleration does not mean zero loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只提交慣性量級與未涵蓋項目表，不把課堂計算當作船級或繫泊設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Submit inertial magnitude and an omissions table, without treating the classroom result as class or mooring design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只使用平均加速度會漏掉循環載荷，質心估計錯誤則會低估傾覆力矩；需核對質量分布與時序頻率，而非單看設備總重。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using average acceleration misses cyclic loads, while a wrong centre of mass understates overturning effects. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A higher centre of gravity alone is not a stability conclusion because buoyancy, free surfaces and load cases also change; this is traceable weight accounting only.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總重量沒有超過原值，改裝後穩度一定不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Keeping total weight unchanged guarantees unchanged stability after conversion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混用不同高度基準或遺漏永久液體會造成重心偏差；應以重量分類帳、變更單與載況表交叉核對，不能只看最後一個KG數字。
knowledge.textEn: Mixed elevation datums or omitted permanent liquids bias the result. Cross-check category ledgers, change records and load cases instead of reviewing only the final KG value.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
